title: Hearty Smoky Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A smoky and dense Uruguayan dish featuring basil and stir-fry, perfect for a crowd, and paleo-friendly
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the beef cubes, red onion, and red bell pepper onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Stir in chopped fresh basil into the skewers during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
